name: Olifants River
full: Olifants River — Lutzville Valley, Citrusdal Valley remainder & stand-alone wards
terroir: The Olifants River region's remaining ground is a working, largely co-operative wine country on South Africa's arid West Coast, running from Klawer and Vredendal on the Olifants River itself out to Doringbaai on the Atlantic.
lede: The Olifants River region's remaining ground is a working, largely co-operative wine country on South Africa's arid West Coast, running from Klawer and Vredendal on the Olifants River itself out to Doringbaai on the Atlantic.
